g.text: Filled: transferred recall. Open diamonds: candidate ceilings. Intervals: 1,000 paired recording/source-reselection draws,
conditional on unkeyed frames. Solid bars: ceiling difference; hatched: threshold-miss difference. Primary unused_nonpedestrian.
Native height ≥50; BDD occlusion unaligned. Fixed checkpoints; descriptive dataset contrast, G0 pending.
